home_lede: Rampsmith finds WCAG 2.2 AA failures in your Shopify store and fixes them in your own data and theme code, with a dated record of every change.
home_note: Automated checks find many accessibility issues, not all of them. Rampsmith tells you what it checked and what still needs a person.
embedded_failed: Rampsmith could not reach your store. Reload the app to try again.
embedded_next_body: Scans, findings and fixes arrive in the next release. Your store's access is set up and kept current.
error_body: Try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, contact support and quote reference {reference}.
dash_empty: Your sites and agency stores will appear here.
signin_lede: Use the passkey saved on this device or in your password manager.
signin_failed: Sign-in did not complete. Try again, or create an account if you do not have one.
register_lede: Your account is protected by a passkey instead of a password.
register_failed: The account could not be created. {reason}
passkeys_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys. Use an up-to-date browser to continue.
passkeys_need_js: Passkeys need JavaScript. Turn it on to sign in.
site_footer_note: Automated checks find only part of all accessibility issues. Rampsmith tells you what it checked and what still needs a person.
site_footer_draft: The privacy policy, terms and addendum are drafts that await attorney review.
site_home_eyebrow: For Shopify stores and the agencies that run them
site_home_find_body: It checks eight page types and four interactive states against WCAG 2.2 A and AA, then ranks what it finds by how much it gets in a shopper's way.
site_home_fix_body: Store data, such as image descriptions, is corrected where it lives. Theme code arrives as exact patches your developer can review as GitHub pull requests.
site_home_record_body: Every fix carries the finding, the WCAG criterion, before and after evidence, who approved it and when. Data fixes undo with one click.
site_home_never_overlay_title: No overlay and no toolbar widget
site_home_never_overlay_body: Nothing is added on top of your storefront. Rampsmith changes the data and the code a barrier comes from.
site_home_never_claims_body: Rampsmith reports what it checked, for example "Passes 41 of 47 automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks". It gives no legal advice and does not say that a store meets any law.
site_home_limits_title: Automated checks are only part of the picture
site_home_limits_body: axe-core, the engine behind most accessibility testing, finds on average 57% of WCAG issues automatically and returns uncertain results as incomplete. Rampsmith lists what automation cannot see and queues uncertain results for a person to review.
site_home_who_owner_body: Exposure ranked in plain language, fixes without touching code, and proof of effort.
site_home_who_agency_body: Exact patches, pull requests, client-ready reports and one dashboard for every store you run.
site_home_who_team_body: Continuous monitoring, regression alerts and an audit trail for a brand with a developer on staff.
site_home_end_body: Check a public site's home page and two linked pages. No account, and nothing is published.
site_how_lede: From the first scan to a dated record of what changed, in four steps.
site_how_s1_body: Rampsmith loads your store's pages in a real browser, with the menu opened by keyboard, the cart drawer open, a variant picked and the first popup found. It also audits store data without a browser.
site_how_s2_body: Findings are ranked by impact on shoppers and by how often that failure appears in complaints. Each one names its WCAG 2.2 success criterion and shows the element.
site_how_s3_body: You approve every change. Rampsmith proposes it, shows exactly what will change, and applies it only after you say yes.
site_how_s4_body: A follow-up scan proves the finding is gone and nothing new appeared. Scans repeat on a schedule, and a failure that returns is surfaced.
site_how_channels_lede: Rampsmith never writes your theme files through Shopify's API. Each kind of fix takes the route that keeps you in control.
site_how_ch_data_what: Image descriptions, titles and other content Shopify holds as data, changed through the Admin API.
site_how_ch_pr_what: Exact code patches for a theme kept in GitHub. Your team reviews and merges them.
site_how_ch_pkg_what: A copy of your theme with the patches applied, checked by a preview re-scan, for you to upload yourself.
site_how_ch_pkg_undo: Switch back to the original theme.
site_how_people_body: Some barriers need human judgement: whether alt text says what matters, whether a flow makes sense with a screen reader, how third-party app code behaves. Rampsmith lists these in its report and, for third-party apps, drafts a notice you can send to the vendor.
site_how_checks_pages: Page types: home, collection, product, cart, search results, customer account login, standard page and blog article.
site_how_checks_states: Interactive states: main navigation opened by keyboard, the cart drawer after add to cart, a changed variant picker and the first modal or popup found.
site_how_checks_out: Shopify-controlled checkout pages are outside what any app can change, so Rampsmith leaves them out.
site_pricing_lede: Four plans, billed through Shopify App Pricing in US dollars. Yearly prices include two months free.
site_plan_pro_scans: Daily; every template variant, 25 samples each
site_plan_free_fixes: Data fixes for the first 25 images
site_plan_starter_fixes: Data fixes; the 6 core recipes as GitHub pull requests
site_plan_growth_fixes: Adds every recipe, description rewrites and regression alerts
site_plan_pro_fixes: Adds AI proposals for custom widgets, multi-language statements and a priority queue
site_pricing_matrix_lede: Features your plan does not include stay visible and are marked with the plan that unlocks them.
site_feature_core_prs: The 6 core recipes as GitHub pull requests
site_feature_all_recipes: Every recipe as a pull request
site_pricing_note_billing: Shopify merchants pay through Shopify App Pricing, so charges appear on your Shopify invoice.
site_pricing_note_agency: The agency dashboard is free. Commercial terms for agencies are still being decided.
site_pricing_note_free: The Free plan is not a trial. Its 25 alt-text drafts are a one-time allowance.
site_pricing_note_limits: Automated checks find only part of all accessibility issues on every plan.
site_scan_lede: Enter the address of a public website. Rampsmith checks its home page and two linked pages against WCAG 2.2 A and AA at one screen size, then shows how many checks failed, with three examples of each kind.
site_scan_know_partial: The check is automated and partial. Automated testing finds on average 57% of WCAG issues, so a clean result does not mean a site has no barriers.
site_scan_know_limits: Each visitor can run 3 scans a day, and each site can be scanned once a day. A result is kept for 24 hours.
site_scan_know_robots: Rampsmith follows the site's robots.txt. If a site shows a bot check, Rampsmith stops; it never solves or bypasses one.
site_scan_know_private: A result is shown only to you, is not indexed by search engines and is never published.
site_scan_challenge_label: Check that you are not a bot
site_scan_noscript: The bot check needs JavaScript. Turn it on to run a scan.
site_scan_closed_title: The free scanner is closed for now
site_scan_closed_body: The bot check that protects the scanner is not switched on yet, so scanning is closed. Please come back later.
site_scan_err_invalid: That does not look like a website address.
site_scan_err_scheme: Only http and https addresses can be scanned.
site_scan_err_credentials: Remove the user name and password from the address.
site_scan_err_port: Only the standard web ports can be scanned. Remove the port number.
site_scan_err_address: Enter a website name, not an IP address.
site_scan_err_private: Only public websites can be scanned.
site_scan_err_challenge: The bot check did not pass. Run it again, then scan.
site_scan_err_challenge_down: The bot check could not be reached. Try again in a few minutes.
site_scan_err_rate_ip: You have used today's 3 scans. Try again in about {hours} hours.
site_scan_err_rate_domain: That site was scanned in the last day and its result is no longer kept. Try again in about {hours} hours.
site_scan_err_failed: The scan could not be completed. Try again later.
site_scan_err_robots: The site's robots.txt asks scanners to stay away, so Rampsmith did not scan it.
site_scan_err_bot_challenge: The site shows a bot check. Rampsmith does not solve or bypass those, so it stopped.
site_scan_err_unreachable: The site could not be reached.
site_scan_not_connected_title: The scanner is not connected yet
site_scan_not_connected_body: This page is ready, but the scanning service is not connected to it yet, so nothing was scanned and this attempt did not count against your daily scans.
site_scan_result_cached: This is the result from the last 24 hours.
site_scan_result_fixture: Test data. This is a fixed sample for testing the page, not a real scan.
site_scan_result_passes: Passes {passed} of {total} automated WCAG 2.2 AA checks
site_scan_result_none: No failures were found by the automated checks on these pages. That does not mean the site has no barriers.
site_scan_result_partial: This result is automated and partial. It cannot see what needs a person, such as whether alt text says what matters or how a flow works with a screen reader.
site_legal_draft: Draft — attorney review required. Not published.
site_legal_draft_body: This text is a working draft. It has not been reviewed by an attorney, may contain placeholders in square brackets, and is not yet in force.
site_statement_draft: Draft — placeholders in square brackets are completed before publication.
site_statement_draft_body: The statement describes what Rampsmith aims for and how it is tested. It is not a claim about the result.
site_sub_lede: The companies that process data for Rampsmith. We change this list only with 30 days' notice to customers.
site_sub_cloudflare_data: Evidence files; visitor IP address for Turnstile
site_sub_anthropic_data: None: images and product text only
site_sub_github_role: Pull requests, when the customer connects it
site_sub_stripe_role: Billing for customers who do not use Shopify
site_sub_draft: This list follows the data governance plan and is confirmed when the privacy policy is published.
